next_step: Start Dedicated POC (canary routing) week of 2026-03-15 — validate latency & cost targets
notes: Inbound lead from product team — evaluating inference economics for in-app assistant and doc search.
Primary ask: move from prototype (hosted API) -> Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower p99 latency variability.
Quoted on call: 'we need consistent sub-200ms p50 for chat flows and <400ms p95 for search reranks', emphasis on perceived snappiness.
Security: SSO (SAML) + KMS integration mandatory; retention & residency questions from legal (EU customers), want audit logs for tokens.
Cost sensitivity: moderate; willing to pay reserved capacity if ROI vs hosted API > 2x reduction in per-token cost at scale.
Model preference: open models first (Llama-family variants), want ability to route to quantized variants for cost/perf tradeoffs.
POC ask: dedicated GPU pool for a week with canary rollout, traffic split plan, and measured rollback conditions.
Canary plan discussed: start 5% customer traffic -> dedicated pool (us-east) running model-v1-quant; ramp to 25% if metrics stable.
Fallback routing: if capacity or errors spike, auto-fallback to hosted_api model-small in us-east; region failover to eu-west if us-east has degraded health.
Rollback triggers defined on call: >1% error rate OR p95 latency >500ms sustained for 2 minutes -> automatic rollback to hosted API variant.
Metrics to capture in POC: p50/p95 latency, error rate, token cost per 1k, tail latency distribution, infra CPU/GPU utilization, cold-starts.
Evaluation success criteria: 30% lower per-token cost vs hosted + p95 within 20% of hosted baseline and no missing feature parity (streaming, function-calls).
Action items from demo: SE to share Dedicated sizing guidance, Redwood pricing delta spreadsheet, quickstart for VPC peering.
Quote from engineering: 'we like the KV cache idea for prefix-heavy flows; need to validate cache hit rate with real queries.'

use_case_summary: Primary: in-product AI assistant (chat) + contextual doc search and reranking. Need sub-200ms p50 for chat and reliable rerank latencies; must support streaming & function/tool calls. Expect gradual ramp to 1-2M tokens/day within 12 months.
technical_requirements: Throughput target: steady 200 QPS for reranking peak windows, burst to 500 QPS
Model variants: production -> model-v1-quant (dedicated), fallback -> model-smoke-hosted (hosted API), keep ability to A/B to larger model for quality checks
Routing: policy-based routing by latency/cost/region, canary at 5% then step up; automatic fallback to hosted when capacity constrained
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route tracing, retention of eval logs for 90 days
Security: SAML SSO, KMS for keys, audit logs ingestion to their SIEM
poc_plan: Duration: 7 days (initial), optional extended 21-day test for scale validation
Canary: day1 — 5% traffic to Dedicated pool (us-east) running model-v1-quant; monitor 15-min windows
Ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 50% contingent on health checks and cost metrics
Fallback: immediate reroute to hosted model-small if error rate >1% or p95 latency >500ms for 2 minutes
Region failover test: scheduled lab test switching to eu-west for a subset to validate residency/recovery
Rollback: automated rollback policy + manual override in Console; rollback criteria documented and agreed
Success metrics: cost per 1k tokens within forecast band, p95 within 20% of hosted baseline, no missing features (streaming/function-calls)
